args.headline: Set the message rewrite attempt cap
args.prompt:
The system needs to cap how many times an agent can rewrite a rejected message. Should this cap be 3 or 5?

Option 1: Cap at 3 attempts
- Consequence: Ends a stuck loop sooner, preventing excessive retries

Option 2: Cap at 5 attempts
- Consequence: Gives the agent more room to fix its own text and resolve issues

args.headline: Set the message rewrite attempt cap
args.prompt:
The system needs to cap how many times an agent may rewrite a rejected message. Should this cap be 3 or 5?

Option 1: Cap at 3 attempts
Consequence: Ends a stuck loop sooner. This prevents excessive retries.

Option 2: Cap at 5 attempts
Consequence: Gives the agent more room to fix its own text. This allows better issue resolution.
